name: persian-dev-kit
description: Persian rendering and writing style for Claude Code, plus a guard against writing dependency versions from memory.

plugins.name: persian-rendering
plugins.description: Persian renders correctly in the Claude Code panel: bundled Vazirmatn webfont, and per-block direction decided by counting rather than by the first strong character.

plugins.name: persian-style
plugins.description: Claude answers Persian in everyday spoken Persian, not literary or translated-from-English Persian. Injected only when your message contains Persian.

plugins.name: verify-first
plugins.description: Check a claim before building on it, and never write a dependency version from memory. Catches version pins as they are written.
